# awscc_personalize_metric_attribution (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Personalize::MetricAttribution



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `dataset_group_arn` (String) The ARN of the destination dataset group.
- `metric_attribution_arn` (String) The ARN of the metric attribution.
- `metrics` (Attributes List) A list of metric attributes for the metric attribution. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `metrics_output_config` (Attributes) The output configuration details for the metric attribution. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics_output_config))
- `name` (String) The name of the metric attribution.
- `status` (String) The status of the metric attribution.

- `event_type` (String) The metric's event type.
